disputes.issue: Arithmetic loophole tilted toward 'supported': if all legacy CardVault sustainer schedules were still running, CV-BATCH deposits would be far larger (~$43K/month for 702 profiles plus ~$25.5K corporate/tenant), while observed deposits (~$25.9K) match corporate+tenant almost exactly; a careful reader could conclude the deposits are not sustainer money.
disputes.resolution: E6 now states the vendor did not inventory how many sustainer schedules were native to CardVault (still running) vs DonorPoint-triggered (stopped at cutover), keeping both readings live; rationale updated.

disputes.issue: Same loophole as I4 tilted toward 'contradicted'.
disputes.resolution: Resolved by the E6 rewording; expected answer unchanged.

disputes.issue: E8 complaint category 'was asked to re-enter my card' conflicted with E6 (no donor contact was ever sent) and hinted at GiveLedger outreach.
disputes.resolution: Reworded E8 category to 'my monthly gift seems to have stopped' or 'my monthly receipts stopped'.

disputes.resolution: Removed the editorial prefix; expected unchanged.
